_published_faq.name: How do I add Figaro Immobilier to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Figaro Immobilier to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://immobilier.lefigaro.fr/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Figaro Immobilier MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Figaro Immobilier scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Figaro Immobilier MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Figaro Immobilier provides these MCP tools: search_locations and listings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Figaro Immobilier?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Figaro Immobilier in e-commerce on the Manufact MCP catalog include Shop, eYantra Corporate Gifting, Get My eSIM, Is It Legit by M8ven, and Pricewatcha.

_published_faq.name: Does Figaro Immobilier MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Figaro Immobilier does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Figaro Immobilier is developed by Figaro Classifieds. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
